SELECT DISTINCT T1.language 
FROM foreign_data AS T1 
JOIN cards AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
JOIN sets AS T3 ON T2.setCode = T3.code 
WHERE T3.mcmName = 'Archenemy' AND T3.code = 'ARC'
